posts.title: How OpenAI scaled Habitat storage for ChatGPT with multi-tenancy, caching and Cosmos DB
posts.summary: OpenAI describes part two of scaling Habitat, the online storage behind ChatGPT. It covers reliable multi-tenancy, a global caching layer, and Azure Cosmos DB, which together yield about 12x faster reads.

posts.title: Cloudflare rebuilds Pingora cache to coordinate range requests, halving R2 p99
posts.summary: Naive byte-range caching can waste gigabytes of origin bandwidth on small requests. Cloudflare reworked the Pingora cache so partial fetches are coordinated automatically. This cut R2 p99 latency in half.

posts.title: HPTS 2026 notes: hardware, object storage, failures, consensus and lakehouses
posts.summary: Murat Demirbas's notes on HPTS days 2 and 3 cover GPU and database hardware limits, object storage, failure handling, consensus and lakehouses. They are a condensed summary of talks from practitioners and researchers.
